title: dir2mcp_recheck_path
description: Ask a running server in watch mode to reconcile one path under the corpus root now, instead of at the next periodic safety rescan (SPEC 15.13). Optional extension: served only when the server runs the file watcher and is not read-only; otherwise absent from tools/list and TOOL_UNAVAILABLE on call. The call enqueues the reconcile and returns; it does not wait for ingestion.

rel_path.description: Path relative to the corpus root, with the grammar and normalization of dir2mcp_open_file's rel_path ('/' as the separator, no leading '/'). A file or a directory; '.' names the root itself. A path that resolves outside the root is PATH_OUTSIDE_ROOT. An excluded path is accepted and reconciled as ineligible. A path that does not exist is accepted: the reconcile tombstones what was indexed there.

recursive.description: For a directory: when true (default) reconcile the whole subtree; when false, only the regular files that are its direct children. Ignored for a file.

rel_path.description: The normalized corpus-relative path the request resolved to ('.' for the root).

kind.description: What one stat of the resolved path found at call time: a regular file, a directory, or nothing (missing).

queued.description: true when this call added a reconcile request; false when a request for the same normalized rel_path was already pending (the queue holds at most one per path).

pending.description: Number of reconcile requests pending after this call, this one included when queued is true.
